designSystem.name: XGen MRP Design System
designSystem.description: A consistent design system for the XGen MRP application with enhanced color system through Tailwind CSS custom properties

colorTheme.philosophy: Enhanced color system using Tailwind CSS custom properties to automatically apply subtle backgrounds throughout the application. Standard classes like bg-white now use #F2F3F4 instead of pure white.
colorTheme.implementation: Colors are defined in CSS custom properties and automatically applied through standard Tailwind classes. No need for manual bg-[#F2F3F4] usage - just use bg-white, bg-card, bg-muted, etc.

colorTheme: Use bg-[#F2F3F4] as the primary background for cards and main content areas
Apply bg-[#F8F9FA] for nested content or secondary panels within cards
Use bg-[#FAFBFC] for dialog bodies and highlighted sections
Implement elevated surfaces (bg-white/90) for modals and floating elements
Combine backgrounds with appropriate borders (border-slate-200/60) for definition
Use color variants (blue, green, amber, red) sparingly for status indicators and important metrics
Always provide dark mode equivalents for all background colors
Maintain consistent opacity levels (50-90%) for visual hierarchy
dialogDesign: Always include a clear title and description
Provide a way to close the dialog (X button or Cancel)
Use consistent button ordering (Cancel on left, primary action on right)
For large dialogs, use a fixed header and footer with scrollable content
For complex forms, consider a multi-step approach
Always show loading states during async operations
Use elevated backgrounds (bg-white/90) for dialog headers and footers
Apply subtle backgrounds (bg-[#FAFBFC]) for dialog bodies
formDesign: Provide helper text for complex fields
Use appropriate input types (date pickers, selects, etc.)
Consider using grid layouts for dense forms
tableDesign: Always wrap tables in bg-card containers with rounded corners for visual definition
Use bg-muted/50 for table headers to distinguish from data rows
Apply hover:bg-muted/30 to data rows for interactive feedback
Include comprehensive search and filter capabilities in the toolbar
Use consistent row actions with dropdown menus for multiple actions
Implement pagination for datasets with >50 items
Allow column sorting where appropriate with clear visual indicators
Use skeleton loaders or loading states during data fetching
Provide empty states with helpful icons and action buttons
Include error states with retry mechanisms
Use consistent cell padding (p-4) for readability
Implement responsive design - hide less important columns on mobile
Add summary cards above tables when showing key metrics
Use sidebar layouts for complex filtering requirements
Maintain consistent spacing between page header, summary cards, and table (gap-6)
iconUsage: Use icons consistently across similar components
Pair icons with text for better clarity
Keep icon sizes consistent within contexts
Use color to enhance meaning, not as the sole indicator

twoPanel.description: Two-panel selector pattern as seen in AddMaterialDialog and CreateCustomerOrderDialog
twoPanel.key: This pattern features a left panel for browsing/searching and a right panel for selected items
implementation: Use grid layout with 1 column on mobile, 2 columns on desktop
Each panel is a Card with flex-column layout
Left panel contains search and scrollable list of items
Right panel contains selected items with quantity/price inputs
Both panels have fixed headers with scrollable content areas
